prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Germakochi, tall hairy forest man of Laz folklore.
ANATOMY: ONE tall living creature intermediate between a MONKEY and HUMAN: one head, two eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs; entire muscular body covered in dense tangled dark fur, short broad monkeylike muzzle and humanlike curious eyes [germakochi-c04,germakochi-c08]. Opaque coarse dark cloth covering pelvis, no nudity. No horns, wings, spikes or added anatomy.
MOMENT: Lean out from behind a huge wet forest tree and reach one powerful long-fingered hand curiously toward viewer, head tilts in intense inquisitive scrutiny; parted lips show natural teeth but NOT roaring or attacking. Other hand grips tree bark. This huge close encounter feels overwhelming without making him evil.
POWER: No invented powers; curiosity and communicating with humans [germakochi-c05,germakochi-c10]. No fire or cannibal scene; select curious rather than hostile tale.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; tight waist-up confrontation, tall figure towers naturally above low viewer; body fills almost square, no tiny distant subject.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant amber fire or low moon, deep walnut shadows, hard rim light; ordinary dust, rain or spray as appropriate.
SURFACE: tactile natural hair, coarse cloth, wet scales, skin, wood or stone; premium painterly brushwork, no plastic.
SETTING: Deep Laz forest [germakochi-c04,germakochi-c08].
MOOD: imposing and active, never cute, calm or decorative. Helpful and living sacred figures remain benevolent, dignified and awe-inspiring.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Germakochi, tall hairy forest man of Laz folklore

visual_requirements.description: Tall hair-covered being between monkey and human

aura: Documented anatomy and action create imposing presence without generic aura.
artistic_choices: Choose curious peaceful account, not cannibal variant. Fur hue, cloth modesty and moonlit rain editorial.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native inspected: tall densely hairy monkey-human being, one head/two eyes, two arms with natural fingers, opaque pelvic cloth, legs partly cropped. Massive close hand and curious forward lean provide overwhelming encounter, not aggression. Forest background and tactile wet hair, no invented powers, text or aura. Strong at 200px; all seven Sangar criteria pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px + both-hand crops. A tall forest being between monkey and human: one head, two deep-set curious humanlike eyes, a short broad apelike muzzle, and a body entirely covered in dense wet matted dark fur (germakochi-c04/c08). Exactly two arms — a huge long-fingered right hand reaching gently toward the viewer (thumb + four fingers confirmed in crop, no extra digits) and a left hand gripping the mossy tree; a coarse opaque cloth wrap covers the pelvis (no nudity); legs are in lower shadow. The parted lips and curious forward lean read as inquisitive contact, not aggression — the curious non-hostile account, not the cannibal variant (germakochi-c05/c10). Deep wet Laz forest with one warm low light source and rim light. No invented powers, aura, text or borrowed design; dominates the frame and reads as a towering forest ape-man at 200px.
